scenarios.name: create-customer
scenarios.why: the credit check: PUT CONTAINERs CIPA-CIPE on CIPCREDCHANN, RUN TRANSID OCR1-OCR5 CHANNEL (each child a copy of the channel as it is at its RUN), DELAY FOR SECONDS(3) -- the wait at which the five children run, in RUN order, each DELAYing 1 or 2 seconds (FUNCTION RANDOM seeded by its EIBTASKN, 4243-4247) and scoring its own container -- then FETCH ANY NOSUSPEND five times (each child completed before the parent's 3 seconds: first to complete first, RUN order on a tie, X18) and GET CONTAINER of each reply channel, NOTFND RESP2 1 on the sixth, the average score and a review date; then the date of birth passes, ENQ, READ UPDATE / REWRITE of the CUSTOMER control record (customer 42 -> 43), WRITE CUSTOMER 9876540000000043, INSERT PROCTRAN 'OCC', DEQ; 'Y' with the new key

scenarios.name: born-before-1601
scenarios.why: the same credit check (five children, FETCH ANY x6), then DATE-OF-BIRTH-CHECK refuses a year before 1601 ('O') BEFORE its CEEDAYS call: a path that never reaches the L1 CEEDAYS call (its 10-byte picture over 8-byte 'YYYYMMDD' has slack ruled blank, owner 2026-10-27); no customer written

scenarios.name: born-in-the-future
scenarios.why: the same credit check (another five children), then DATE-OF-BIRTH-CHECK refuses a date of birth after today: 'N' / 'Y', no customer written, no PROCTRAN row

scenarios.name: born-30-feb
scenarios.why: the same credit check, then DATE-OF-BIRTH-CHECK's CEEDAYS refuses 30/02/1985 (L1: the picture's 2 slack bytes ruled blank, owner 2026-10-27): fail code 'Z', no customer written

scenarios.name: born-over-150
scenarios.why: the same credit check, CEEDAYS accepts 01/01/1700 (L1 slack ruled blank), then DATE-OF-BIRTH-CHECK refuses an age over 150: no customer written

scenarios.name: control-read-sysiderr-retried
scenarios.why: READ UPDATE of the CUSTOMER control record answers SYSIDERR once: the retry loop DELAYs and READs again, NORMAL (1298:true)

faults.why: 130 on the first READ UPDATE of the control record

scenarios.name: control-read-io-error
scenarios.why: READ UPDATE of the control record answers IOERR: any RESP other than NORMAL and SYSIDERR gives 'N' '4' (1316:true)

faults.why: 17 on the READ UPDATE of the control record

scenarios.name: control-rewrite-sysiderr-retried
scenarios.why: REWRITE of the control record answers SYSIDERR once: the retry loop REWRITEs again, NORMAL (1332:true)

scenarios.name: control-rewrite-io-error
scenarios.why: REWRITE of the control record answers IOERR: 'N' '4' (1347:true)

scenarios.name: write-sysiderr-retried
scenarios.why: WRITE of the new CUSTOMER record answers SYSIDERR once: the retry loop WRITEs again, NORMAL (1039:true)

scenarios.name: write-sysiderr-exhausted
scenarios.why: WRITE of the new CUSTOMER record answers SYSIDERR on every try: the 100 retries end still SYSIDERR, so RESP is not NORMAL and the program reports 'N' '1' (1064:true)

scenarios.name: run-transid-first-transiderr
scenarios.why: The first RUN TRANSID (OCR1) answers TRANSIDERR RESP2 1 (X18): no child starts, the failure arm sets COMM-FAIL-CODE B and leaves

scenarios.name: fetch-any-notfinished-nothing-retrieved
scenarios.why: The first FETCH ANY answers NOTFINISHED 52 with no reply retrieved: WS-CREDIT-CHECK-ERROR Y (657/664 true, 371 true)

scenarios.name: fetch-any-notfinished-after-a-reply
scenarios.why: The second FETCH ANY answers NOTFINISHED 52 after one reply was retrieved: the average of what came (664 false)

faults.why: one reply retrieved, none more in time

scenarios.name: fetch-any-notfnd-nothing-retrieved
scenarios.why: The first FETCH ANY answers NOTFND RESP2 1 with no reply retrieved (780 true)

scenarios.name: fetch-any-notfnd-after-a-reply
scenarios.why: The second FETCH ANY answers NOTFND RESP2 1 after one reply was retrieved (780 false)

scenarios.name: put-container-first-containererr
scenarios.why: The first PUT CONTAINER (CIPA) answers CONTAINERERR RESP2 18 (X17): the command is not performed, the failure arm sets COMM-FAIL-CODE A and leaves (565 true)

scenarios.name: get-container-first-containererr
scenarios.why: The first GET CONTAINER of a reply channel answers CONTAINERERR RESP2 10 (X17): the score is 0 and the review date is the original date (900 true)

scenarios.name: ceeloct-local-time-unavailable
scenarios.why: CEELOCT answers CEE2F3 (severity 3, message 2531: the local time was not available from the system, the one failure IBM lists): the call leaves its outputs, the DOB check refuses with WS-DATE-OF-BIRTH-ERROR Y and no COMM-FAIL-CODE (the DISPLAY 'CEEDLOCT failed' arm), no customer written

faults.why: the IF NOT CEE000 OF FC after CEELOCT is true

scenarios.name: fetch-any-first-child-abends
scenarios.why: The credit agency child OCR1 abends: FETCH ANY answers COMPSTATUS ABEND (853 WHEN DFHVALUE(ABEND))

faults.why: CRDTAGY1's DELAY FOR SECONDS fails: its RESP NOT NORMAL arm runs
its LINK ABNDPROC (no RESP) fails, so the child abends and ABNDPROC writes nothing (R1)

scenarios.name: fetch-any-first-child-secerror
scenarios.why: FETCH ANY returns the first child with COMPSTATUS SECERROR (the child failed a security check): 853 WHEN DFHVALUE(SECERROR) (951) runs, COMM-FAIL-CODE 'G'

faults.why: the first child FETCH ANY returns has COMPSTATUS SECERROR (X18, ASSUMED: the region's security manager refused the child; none is modelled)

notes: CBSA's create-customer service (CRECUST, LINKed by BNK1CCS -- transaction OCCS -- with its SUBPGM-PARMS, the CRECUST copybook's layout). #4950: its credit check is the async API. It PUTs its COMMAREA into containers CIPA-CIPE of channel CIPCREDCHANN, RUNs transactions OCR1-OCR5 ("child_programs": CRDTAGY1-5, as the CSD's TRANSACTION definitions name them) with that channel, DELAYs 3 seconds, then FETCH ANY NOSUSPENDs the replies, GETs each child's container back from its reply channel, and averages the scores. The schedule is the harness's (oracle_assumptions.md X18, ASSUMED: a child runs at its parent's wait, in RUN order, and completes at its dispatch plus its own DELAYs; a task takes no processor time, X4); each child's events and the containers it leaves are compared (the CHILD event). FUNCTION RANDOM is the oracle's generator (C12) seeded by EIBTASKN: the parent's stated 4242 (X21), a child's 4242 plus its RUN number. Then the date-of-birth check, ENQ of the customer counter, the CUSTOMER control record READ UPDATE / REWRITE, the new CUSTOMER record, a PROCTRAN 'OCC' row (Db2), DEQ. CUSTOMER, ABNDFILE and PROCTRAN are compared after every scenario. Not reached: a child that does not complete within the 3 seconds (every CRDTAGY delays 1 or 2), a credit agency's failure paths, and the failures no fault can be injected on (#6271: a busy ENQ without NOSUSPEND, DEQ); PUT CONTAINER, GET CONTAINER, RUN TRANSID, FETCH ANY and CEELOCT (CEE2F3, #6882) are fault scenarios; so are the SYSIDERR retries and other RESPs of the CUSTOMER READ UPDATE, REWRITE and WRITE are fault scenarios. Data: seed.sql is cbsa-creacc's, customer.txt cbsa-custctrl's (the control record says 42 customers), both SYNTHETIC. Derived from the CICS Bank Sample Application (CBSA, github.com/cicsdev/cics-banking-sample-application-cbsa; Copyright IBM Corp. 2023), licensed under the Eclipse Public License 2.0: LICENSE here is the corpus's own; NOTICE says what is derived. #4952, #5089 -- ASSUMED (register): (1) L1: DATE-OF-BIRTH-CHECK's CEEDAYS call passes a length-10 picture and date over 8 'YYYYMMDD' bytes; the picture's 2 extra bytes are the storage after the item, which IBM does not specify: the owner ruled them blank (2026-10-23, restated 2026-10-27, CRECUST only, ASSUMED), as the blank picture tail (2026-10-14), so create-customer and born-in-the-future run; (2) X18: the child schedule is ASSUMED. L4 is settled: FC is the 12-byte token LE writes (its 8-byte CONDITION-TOKEN-VALUE is the group inside it). Not recorded as evidence here: a proof rests on those assumptions, so read its level from the evidence report, never from this note. Burned estate (CBSA).
